title: [review] slot_claim.py:100: signature_valid field is settable via constructor
description: The signature_valid dataclass field defaults to False but can be set to True in the SlotClaim constructor. Code in resolve_slot_conflict (lines 288-295) trusts this cached field and skips signature verification if signature_valid=True. An attacker who controls claim construction (not via from_cbor) could set signature_valid=True to bypass verification. Fix: add init=False to the field() call to prevent constructor setting, or always verify in resolve_slot_conflict regardless of cached state.
close_reason: Fixed: added init=False to signature_valid field, preventing constructor bypass of signature verification. Updated tests to use proper verification path via pubkeys.
